turns.name: Span

tables.name: gold_investment_report_monthly_entity_summary
tables.purpose: Monthly summary of net worth by entity in USD and SGD
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE gold_investment_report_monthly_entity_summary AS SELECT report_month, entity, SUM(net_worth_usd) AS total_net_worth_usd, SUM(net_worth_sgd) AS total_net_worth_sgd FROM gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly GROUP BY report_month, entity
